listing.jobDescription:
Job Description
- Responsible for testing stability samples, release samples, and validation samples for clinical products, including protein concentration, DAR, peptide mapping, CEX, moisture content, and other physicochemical assays.
- Responsible for method qualification, method transfer, and method validation for protein concentration, DAR, peptide mapping, CEX, moisture content, and other physicochemical methods.
- Responsible for qualification of laboratory equipment.
- Responsible for coordinating and following up on the maintenance and calibration of relevant equipment in the AST Physicochemical Laboratory.
- Responsible for sample management activities in the AST Physicochemical Laboratory.
- Provide technical support for deviations and investigations from the Operations QC team, including OOX investigations and product impact assessments for events potentially related to product quality.
- Comply with company EHS policies and procedures, fulfill EHS-related responsibilities, and promptly report EHS incidents, hazards, and risks.

Qualifications & Competencies
- Bachelor's degree or above in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Medicinal Chemistry, Pharmacy, Biology, Chemistry, or a related discipline.
- Good command of English and computer skills; CET-4 (College English Test Band 4) or above.
- Positive, responsible, and willing to learn and take initiative.
- Good teamwork, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
- Good communication and interpersonal skills.
listing.title: 理化分析师 Physiochemical Analyst
